meta.source: Renewables.ninja MERRA-2 (CC BY-NC 4.0), Vestas V162 5600 at 120 m against the existing file series (Vestas V90 2000 at 80 m; fresh-fetch check in ['Free State', 'Kwazulu Natal']), at the 98 sites of profile_sites.json with their weights, local_time=true; sample years [2019].
meta.method: Per region, mean modern-turbine output in 50 bins of current-turbine output, fitted on the sample years and applied to every year of profiles_regional_multiyear.json after removing its fleet bias factor; clipped at 1. Each year keeps its own weather. Uncorrected: the correction for new wind is applied in index.html (WIND_NEW_CORR).
meta.use: New wind only. Existing farms keep profiles_regional_multiyear.json.
meta.new_wind_correction: none in this file; index.html WIND_NEW_CORR
